diagnosis: Check C6, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF3 (failed hydraulic inspection), passed in 100% of rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to PF3. The model consistently correctly identifies P-6's disposition as 'aintenance hold' based solely on public information, suggesting that the relationship between item status and maintenance holds is a predictable pattern for the model.

C6.why: The failed hydraulic inspection changes P-6 from an ordinary disposition to maintenance hold and requires completion or tracking of the shop's hydraulic repair assessment.
